d:
Raat ke 3:11 baje, ek khaali army truck ki fogged khidki par likha milta hai “Convoy Found.” Driver Raghav gayab hai, aur Kaalranga Military Base ke aas-paas goonjti marching ki awaazein ek purane raaz ki taraf ishara karti hain. Kya Raghav ka saamna un gumshuda soldiers se hua, jinka aakhri message aaj bhi sunayi deta hai? Suniye Kaalranga ke uss khaufnaak raaz ki kahaani, jahan dhundh ke saath kuch aisa laut kar aata hai jo kabhi gaya hi nahi.
Dekhiye Sannata
